caption: The drawing consists of a detailed grayscale pencil rendering of an eagle perched on an ornate-scroll pedestal, occupying the upper portion of the image. The eagle is shown in a side view, with its left wing raised and feathers carefully delineated. The head is turned slightly to the right, with a prominent beak and eye visible. The pedestal beneath the eagle is decorated with a volute, resembling the architectural feature found in classical columns. In the lower portion of the drawing, separated by a horizontal line, there are three smaller line-art sketches. Each sketch depicts an eagle from different angles and variations, focusing on simplified outlines and structural elements, including bases with vertical lines and block patterns. The paper color is beige, and the artist's name "Westmacott" is signed near the lower right of the main eagle rendering. There is a scale marked below the central eagle in the lower section. The overall composition is contained within a single rectangular frame drawn in pencil.
title: Eagle
